notes:
- Home shows your files as big pictures on shelves: recent, by kind and by where they came from, such as WhatsApp, Mail or Safari.
- Find a file by what you remember: a word inside a PDF or a picture, the app it came from, or roughly when.
- Press Command-Shift-Space anywhere to find a file without opening the window.
- Browse folders as cards with item counts, with a path bar, two panes side by side and an Inspector.
- Clean up shows old, large and never-opened files, and duplicates, in one place. Everything goes to the Trash and can be put back.
- Tidy Downloads in one click, or go through it one file at a time with a single key per file.
- Cut, paste, new file, copy path, open in Terminal or your editor, and show hidden files, all from the right-click menu.
- Code projects are left out of shelves and clean-up, so build folders do not bury your own files.
- Never opened can leave out small files and code and text files, both remembered.
- Your files never leave your Mac. Findigo reads them on this computer only.
- A free 7-day trial. After it, everything you see stays visible and searchable.
